source.question: Which wells need attention right now, and why? Forecast the next 12 months of oil for the well that needs it most.

note: Oct 28 night: finding 5, 'The field has stayed within its design limits: peak oil ... water cut ...', is about the limits as a whole, and E3 has water injection over capacity in 3 months by 2010. Round 2's 'water now makes up about 69%' was a false rejection ('up' read as a rise), fixed.

submission.summary: F-12 needs attention most — its downhole pressure gauge has been dead since 2010-10-12 and its water cut is about 69%, with oil rate down sharply; F-14 also needs watching with water cut about 61%. For F-12 the fit suggests the next 12 months at about 359,000 Sm3, range 326,000 to 469,000 Sm3, but the fit is poor so confidence is low.

findings.claim: F-12 needs attention most (alarm): it makes about 1 551 Sm3/d of oil at about 69% water cut and its downhole pressure gauge has read zero since 2010-10-12.
findings.detail: field_screen as of 2010-12-31: oil_rate 1551 Sm3/d, water_cut 0.6939, dead_gauge 81 days 2010-10-12 to 2010-12-31, 123,258 Sm3 oil produced without pressure data, last good 253.9 bar on 2010-10-11; production_monthly 2010-12 water_cut 0.7112, oil_rate 1464 Sm3/d per producing day.

findings.claim: F-12's oil rate shifted down around 2010-05-02, about 55% lower in the period after than before.
findings.detail: detect_events oil_rate: weekly mean 4207 -> 1888 Sm3/d (-55%, -2319 Sm3/d) period after vs before, across 4 weeks each side 3196 -> 2538 (-21%) gradual change, not a step; water_cut regime 2010-02-28: 0.0339 -> 0.57

findings.claim: F-12 is waterflooded with water taking capacity: liquid held about 5 130 Sm3/d in 2010 at 57% water cut, and a bridge plug was set at 3210 m after logs showed water from below.
findings.detail: waterflood by_year 2010: liquid 5130 Sm3/d, choke 53.17%, water_cut 0.5711, oil 873828 Sm3; field voidage replacement 1.08 in 2010, near voidage replacement; production_log 2010-09 at 3210 m: oil_share 0.015 (medium rate), water_share 0.376, so plug could shut little oil and much water; 2009-03 log below 3210 oil 0.146-0.171; well_operations 2010-09-23 plug at 3210 m mid element

findings.claim: F-14 also needs watching (caution): it makes about 2 175 Sm3/d at about 61% water cut and its rate is about 34% lower in the period after early 2010.
findings.detail: field_screen: oil_rate 2175 Sm3/d, water_cut 0.6112, oil_rate_change_90d -0.0778; detect_events oil_rate 2010-01-10: weekly mean 3616 -> 2397 (-34%, -1219 Sm3/d), across 2892->2657 (-8% gradual); water_cut 2009-12-06: 0.059 ->0.53; 2010 by_year liquid 5439 Sm3/d water_cut 0.5536

findings.claim: The field has stayed within its design limits: peak oil about 8 924 Sm3/d and water cut about 67%, both below platform capacities.
findings.detail: field_vs_design design: oil 9000, liquid 13000 Sm3/d, max water_cut 0.80 (water handling 10400 Sm3/d), injection 16000 Sm3/d; field max oil 8924 (2008-12), liquid 10826 (2010-06), water_cut 0.6715 (2010-12), water 7193 Sm3/d; only injection exceeded (17206 max, 3 months)

findings.claim: Next 12 months for F-12 forecast to about 359,000 Sm3 of oil, range 326,000 to 469,000 Sm3, the fit suggests with low confidence.
findings.detail: forecast_production fit harmonic qi 2618 Sm3/d per producing day, di 1.3 per year, b 1.0, window 2010-05-03 to 2010-12-31, n 226, r2_log 0.6847 poor fit warning; cumulative p50 358917 Sm3 (p90 340413 bootstrap, p10 374422 bootstrap), calibrated band p90 325679 p10 468819 from 5 past forecasts, median abs error 0.09131; p50 by model exponential 302374 vs hyperbolic/harmonic 358917, model choice matters

result.levels: alarm: act now; caution: watch; note: for the record

result.scope: whole field, all producers and injectors summed per day, then per month
result.plan_source: Plan for utbygging og drift av Volve (PUD, plan for development and operation), page 23, Table 4.3

water_sm3_per_day.limit: field water handling (derived: liquid capacity x maximum water cut)

result.plan_end_quote: Kumulativ oljeproduksjon inntil minimum økonomisk rate på 2.100 Sm3 /d (gitt Volve oljepris på 18,7 USD/fat) nås er 11,4 MSm3
result.note: These are field and platform limits (PUD p.35 lists the same platform capacities); compare them with field totals, never one well. The maximum water cut is a share at full liquid rate: the water the platform can handle is liquid capacity x maximum water cut (water_sm3_per_day). The field reaching that share at a lower liquid rate means it ran at the design water cut, not over its water capacity. Rates are per calendar day of each month.

result.unit: million Sm3 (MSm3) of oil per calendar year, whole field
result.plan_source: Plan for utbygging og drift av Volve (PUD, plan for development and operation), page 25, Table 4.5
result.note: years: calendar years. The plan assumed first oil in March 2007 and the field started in February 2008, so by_production_year compares each year of production with the plan's year of the same number (plan 2007 with field 2008).

summaries.summary: Skidded rig to F-12. Made up 36" hole opener BHA and RIH with same to 85 m MD.
Made FG check of TDS. Serviced TDS. RIH with 36" hole opener. Drilled 36" hole section from 145 m to 250 m MD.

Drilled 36" hole section to TD at 258 m MD. Displaced well to 1,40 sg mud. POOH with 36" hole opener BHA. Rigged up for running 30" conductor. Ran 30" conductor. Started running 4 3/4" cement stinger inside conductor.
Dismounted and mounted tension cylinders. RIH with production riser to 100 m MD.

RIH with PR tensioner joint. MU PR landing stand, RIH and landed riser. Locked TBC connector. Waited on Simens rig ESD test. Pressure tested PR to 200 bar. Install centralizer and boat collision stool on centralizer deck.
MU tensioner ring assembly. POOH and LD PR RT. Installed hatch on F-12 and suspended operation to F-7.
Skidded rig from F-12 to F-15. Changed wire on port aft crane big hook.
Built scaffolding at the well head deck and in the moon pool. Installed surface riser, BOP and tension cylinders.
Nippled up slick jnt, diverter and torqued up the BOP. RIH and installed the Bowl Protector at 20.9 m. Retrieved the Annulus Insert at 139.9 m. Retrieved the Bowl Protector.
RIH with 10 3/4" Tie Back and made up into sub sea well. Pressure tested Tie Back connector to 345 bars. Attempted to lock the Surface hanger, with the Adjustment sub.
Retrieved landing string. Installed BPV. Nippled down BOP and Riser. Installed dart in BPV. Terminated control lines. Installed extension spool.
Installed the WH extension spool, Xmas tree and the production Co-flex hose.
Leak tested X-mas tree connections to 30/345 bars 5/10 min. Lined up and leak tested production line 50/180 bars 5/10 min. Inflow tested LMV and HMV against BPV.
Sent firing command to E-Fire firing head in TCP guns and perforated well from 3130 to 3281 mMDRT.

Handed well over from Production. RU HMV and DHSV to local control panel. Installed test and bleed manifold on to XMT KWV. Performed line test from KWV to cmt unit. Attempted to leak tested XMT cross to 30/200 bar for 5/10 min.

Operated and greased up leaking PWV. Leak tested XMT cross to 30/200 bar for 5/10 min. Installed WL BOP and riser on XMT. Tested shear seals on WL BOP. Installed combination toolstring in riser. MU lubricator. Leak test WL riser, BOP and lubricator. Equalize and open HMV and DHSV. RIH with combination toolstring and tagged TCP guns at 3260.5 m. Performed correlation log in 7" liner. POOH and prepared for inflow test of HMV.

Inflow tested HMV to 81-5 bar/10 min. Broke lubricator and LD toolstring. Installed PLT toolstring in riser. MU lubricator and leak tested at in-situ sub. Equalized and opened HMV. RIH with PLT toolstring on 7/16" EWL from surface to 2929 m. Performed stationary logging at DHPG depth. Continued RIH from 2929 m to 3030 m to perform shut-in station logs and 4 PLT tool calibration passes in the interval 3030 m to 3255 m MD. Bean up well to 4500 Sm3/day. Performed station logs and 4 high rate flowing PLT passes in the interval 3030 m to 3255 m MD. Choked back flow to 3000 Sm3/day. Performed station logs and 4 medium rate flowing PLT passes in the interval 3030 m to 3255 m MD.

Choked back flow to 1500 Sm3/day. Performed station logs and 4 low rate flowing PLT passes in the interval 3030 m to 3255 m MD. Shut-in well. POOH with PLT toolstring. Inflow tested DHSV, HMV and MMV for handover. BO lubricator and LD toolstring. LD lubricator. RD and LD WL riser.

RD BOP from XMT. Leak test XMT cross, KWV and tree cap. Hand well over to Mærsk Production. Cleared and cleaned rig floor of remaining WL equipment. Transferred operation to F-99 for PRS-and 5-yearly BOP classification.
Waited on access to well. Took over well. Rigged up WL riser and BOP.

RU WL equipment. Installed BHA into lubricator. RIH with PLT. Performed spinner calibration. Performed depth correlation with GR/CCL. Took stationary reading at 2929 m. Ran PLT shut in pass. Took stationary readings. Beaned up well. Waited for stable flow.

Waited for stable flow aprox. 5050 Sm3/d with PLT at 3080 m. Attempted to RIH at various speed. No-go. Reduced flow rate to 3000 Sm3/d. Took stationary readings at 3080, 3155, 3200 and 3250 m. Logged flowing passes between 3030 and 3250 m, down at 40 m/min and up at 10/20/30/40 m/min. Reduced flow rate to 1500 Sm3/d. Logged flowing passes between 3000 and 3250 m, down at 40 m/min and up at 10/20/30/40 m/min. Unable to log down on both flowing rates at 10/20/30 m/min. POOH with PLT. Changed tool string. RIH with 5,72" EVO bridge plug at 800 m.
Installed 5,72" EVO bridge plug at 3210 m mid element. RD wireline pressure control equipment and handed well over to production department.

result.note: Daily reports exist for drilling and for work on the well (wireline, plugs, perforations, production logs), not for days of normal production. summaries.summary: Skidded rig to F-14. Continued changing wires on aft PRS and attempted to change DCI hose, but operation postponed due to weather. Removed hatches and built scaffolding around hatches on all levels. Waited on weather for cranes to pick up CART and BHA.

Drilled 36" hole from 193 m to 204 m MD. Circulated well clean and displaced to 1.40 sg bentonite mud. POOH and LD 36" HO BHA. WOW due to no crane operation. MU and RIH with 30" conductor until x-over joint. Started to install UWG top-up system on upper 35 m.

Positioned 30" conductor at cementing depth at 196.8 m. Mixed and pumped 106 m³ 1.52 SG Tuned Light XL cement slurry. Got returns up F-7, but after 70 m3 pumped, had full returns up F-14. Displaced cement slurry with 6.5 m³ of SW. Waited on cement to set. Meanwhile performed general maintenance. LIned up for flushing of top-up line.

Pressure tested UWG top-up system using the cement unit, rupture disk burst at 53 bars (769 psi). Performed cement top-up job, pumped 10.4 m³, 1.56 SG G-cement 82 bars at 500 lpm. Nippled up the BOP, bell nipple and diverter. Pressure tested the well/BOP/riser to 155 bars 10 min. * Operation suspended due to programmed manitenance in derrick and PRS's.
Set nominal seat protector. Made up 17 1/2" BHA. RIH with 17 1/2" BHA and drilled 20" shoetrack.

Drilled 17 1/2" hole section from 1302 m to 1725 m MD.

Waited on handover of well f-14. Recieved well from production at 19:00. Hooked up local control panel and connected riser. Hooked up BOP control hose and calibrated BOP. Stod by for rigging down WL until scheduled shut-in. Canceled cheduled production shut-in and had to wait on Mærsk to finish off 5-yearly work on tension cylinders in moonpool. Waited on Mærsk Production to shut in well and inflow test HMVand DHSV. Drained lubricator and WL riser. Broke out lubricator and LD toolstring. Tested WL BOP to 20/345 bar for 5/10 min. Disconneced WL riser and BOP from XMT and suspended from rig floor. RD surface lines. Re-arranged and installed hatches on weather deck. RD surface lines and RU HP hose to XMT KWV. Spotted and and hooked up WL equip. Assembled lubricator and riser. Built cable head.
Prepared WL equipment for rig-up and tested PLT and Tractor. Handed well over to well service. Rigged up lower riser and BOP.
Rigged up WL equipment. RIH with PLT/RST. Performed spinner calibration and started to bean up well to test separator with full bore spinner at 2900 m MDRKB.
Performed PLT logging as per program.
Performed RST logging in IC mode, across interval from 3642 to 2970 m.
Continued logging RST in IC mode at 0,5 m/min up to 2975 m. Started tractor and RIH to 3642 m. Logged RST in IC mode at 0,5 m/min from 3642 to 3150 m.

Logged RST from 3150 to 3101 m. RST far detector stopped working. Ran PLT logging pass from 3390 m up to 2970 m at speed 10, 20, 30 and 40 m/min. Took stationary readings at 3200, 3040 and 2970 m. Evaluated data. POOH. LD BHA. Waited on plug equipment from shore. Meanwhile produced well and prepared 5/16" cable equipment.
Waited on plug equipment from shore. Meanwhile produced well and prepared 5/16" cable equipment. Held SJA meeting regarding RD wireline equipment.

Waited on plug equipment from shore. Meanwhile produced well. Received plug equipment. Closed in well. Ran EVO plug on 3 1/8" tractor. Stopped into DHSV. Started to equalize DHSV by pumping MEG into well.

result.note: A production log measures the flow passing each depth while the well flows; going up, it grows past each zone that produces. A share at a depth is the part of the pass's oil or water entering below that depth (1 at the bottom of the well's inflow, 0 above the top zone). comes_in_from_m to to_m holds 90% of each phase's inflow. Only shares are given: the files' rates have no units, and the plots' are downhole volumes. A plug set at a depth shuts off what enters below it: the shares below say what it could remove. Each survey's passes were run at several surface rates. A survey read off pictures carries the checks of that reading.
